svg.aria-label: RCV compared with deep-learning RNA structure predictors: size, speed and RNAs with several conformations
svg.text: RCV next to deep-learning RNA 3D structure predictors
Size, hardware and RNAs that move. RCV: physics + experimental templates, no deep learning, no GPU.
Log scale. Other tools: Python/GPU software not counted.

svg.text: What each tool provides, from its documentation.
¹ structurally distinct conformations from different 2D/template hypotheses (1–30, default 8)
² diffusion samples of one prediction; more seeds give more samples
³ the trRosettaRNA2 paper describes conformers; the default output is one model
⁴ AlphaFold 3 results open in RCV (0.7.3), so RCV's analyses apply to them
⁵ optional: single-sequence mode without databases is less accurate
Sizes and requirements as documented by each tool (checked 7 Nov 2026); weight files measured on the download servers. Accuracy on the 15 CASP16 targets: benchmark/casp16/results.
